root_cause: Valid map data was confused with a valid visible GUI binding. The dirty revision was consumed while the parent was hidden; first opening reused the same revision, leaving literal red frames and all border icons visible.
before_reproduced: Pristine first opening reproduced the user image while logs showed FRA=3 and ui=1 both before and after opening.
fix: Separate cached-data build count from GUI dirty revision; force binding on initial opening, reopening, return and startup without rebuilding valid data.
validation_boundary: Native rendering after real entry/close/map/return callback effects, no territory/control changes before those captures. No mouse or keyboard input was sent.
